data.other_hard: ordinarily resident in an eligible European Union member state; international fee-paying student; new undergraduate entrant for 2027/28 entry
data.evidence_sentence: Be ordinarily resident in an eligible European Union member state.
data.notes: The scholarship is awarded automatically with no separate application, so no deadline is stated. Eligibility is based on ordinary residence in an eligible EU member state, which is not a citizenship rule, so nationality_rule is left empty. The 'eligible countries' list on the page includes many non-EU countries and is cut off mid-list, which conflicts with the EU wording. The award is a tuition fee reduction (net fee £12,060 for 2027/28), not a full waiver or stipend. The 'Hold an offer' condition was read as admitted status.
